doctrine: No capability is treated as verified until a human attaches vendor documentation: doc URL + access date + plan/tier. Until then status stays UNVERIFIED and pipelines must use the listed fallback. Vendor names, where present, are candidates for G2 comparison, not endorsements.

capabilities.evidence_required: vendor docs: resolution/quality specs + access date
capabilities.fallback: generate at max native res, supervise upscale at P3
